def updateMapPoints(points):
    MAP_TILE_URL = "MAPBOX_TILE_URL or OPENMAP_TILE_URL"
    map_data = folium.Map(
        tiles=MAP_TILE_URL,
        zoom_start=19,
        location=points[-1],
        attr=" ",
        max_zoom=100,
    )
    folium.PolyLine(points, color="blue", weight=2.5, opacity=1).add_to(map_data)
